title: A/P Summary: the name and Location headers sort A to Z, then Z to A
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Three vendors have open bills on today's date: {Vendor-A} only at {Location-B}, {Vendor-B} at both locations and {Vendor-C} only at {Location-A}; in name order they read {Vendor-A}, {Vendor-B}, {Vendor-C}. Both location names come after the word "Multiple" in A to Z order.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-04 Alder, {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-04 Birch and {Vendor-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-04 Cedar.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the header of the vendor name column (the first column).
  2. Click the header of the vendor name column (the first column) again.
  3. Click the "Location" header.
  4. Click the "Location" header again.
  5. Click the "Location" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the list was already sorted by name, so this first click reverses it: Z to A, {Vendor-C} above {Vendor-B} above {Vendor-A}.
  • Step 2: back to A to Z: {Vendor-A}, {Vendor-B}, {Vendor-C}.
  • Step 3: the list sorts by Location, A to Z, comparing the words as they read: {Vendor-B} ("Multiple"), then {Vendor-C} ({Location-A}), then {Vendor-A} ({Location-B}).
  • Step 4: Z to A: {Vendor-A}, {Vendor-C}, {Vendor-B}.
  • Step 5: the same as step 3, A to Z again. There is no unsorted state.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S2-R1, A/R Summary and A/P Summary columns: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary: the name column, Location (when shown), Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first. The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R3: “A header that is already the sorted column reverses on its first click.”
  • S6-R5: “The column sorts A to Z on its first click; "Multiple" sorts as text.”
  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
